fato_historico: 1936: King Edward VIII, in one of his few official duties before he abdicates the throne, officially unveils the Canadian National Vimy Memorial.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to stand firm and rooted, much like a grand monument dedicated to peace and memory. It is a good time to reflect on your foundations and values. Perhaps you may find that your persistence acts as a pillar of stability for those around you, allowing you to build lasting beauty in your own life today.
frase_do_dia: Build your own monument to peace through steady, intentional actions.
significado_numero: Representing the infinite balance between your spirit and your material goals.
conselho: Consider your long-term legacy and nurture the foundations of your sanctuary today.
